description: Charging station data for electric vehicle charging Charging station data for electric vehicle charging is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Yifan Wei (Tsinghua University). The data package include charging pile data from 9 stations in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen in China. The original files include messages of pile position, time, vehicle state, SOC (state of charge), current, voltage, temperatrue and etc. The data points are sampled by around 18s for one and a half year. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 271029020 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
